query:
query FindManyCommandMenuItems {
  commandMenuItems {
    ...CommandMenuItemFields
    __typename
  }
}

fragment CommandMenuItemFields on CommandMenuItem {
  id
  universalIdentifier
  applicationId
  coreWorkflowVersionId
  workflowVersionId
  frontComponentId
  frontComponent {
    id
    name
    isHeadless
    __typename
  }
  engineComponentKey
  label
  icon
  shortLabel
  position
  isPinned
  payload {
    ... on PathCommandMenuItemPayload {
      path
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  hotKeys
  conditionalAvailabilityExpression
  conditionalPinnedExpression
  availabilityType
  availabilityObjectMetadataId
  availabilityCoreObjectName
  navigationTargetObjectMetadataId
  pageLayoutId
  isActive
  __typename
}

commandMenuItems.label: 导航到下一个 {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and not isInSidePanel and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "agentChatThread"

commandMenuItems.label: 导航到上一个 {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and not isInSidePanel and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "agentChatThread"

commandMenuItems.label: 创建{objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "INDEX_PAGE" and objectPermissions.canCreateObjectRecords and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectMetadataItem.isUICreatable and objectMetadataItem.isUIEditable and not objectMetadataItem.isRemote

commandMenuItems.label: 共享 {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and featureFlags.IS_RECORD_LEVEL_SHARING_ENABLED and not objectMetadataItem.isSystem and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 删除 {objectLabel}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectPermissions.canSoftDeleteObjectRecords and (isSelectAll or noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")) and (isSelectAll or noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canSoftDelete", false))

commandMenuItems.label: 恢复 {objectLabel}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and (isSelectAll or everyDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")) and objectPermissions.canSoftDeleteObjectRecords and (pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" or hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView) and (isSelectAll or noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canSoftDelete", false))

commandMenuItems.label: 永久销毁 {objectLabel}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and objectPermissions.canDestroyObjectRecords and (isSelectAll or everyDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")) and (pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" or hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView) and (isSelectAll or noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canDelete", false))

commandMenuItems.label: 添加到收藏夹
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: arrayLength(favoriteRecordIds) < numberOfSelectedRecords and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow"

commandMenuItems.label: 从收藏中移除
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: arrayLength(favoriteRecordIds) == numberOfSelectedRecords and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow"

commandMenuItems.label: 合并 {objectLabelPlural}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: not isSelectAll and numberOfSelectedRecords >= 2 and not objectMetadataItem.isSystem and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "dashboard" and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords and objectPermissions.canDestroyObjectRecords and numberOfSelectedRecords <= 9 and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false) and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canDelete", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 与另一个 {objectLabelSingular} 合并
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and not objectMetadataItem.isSystem and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "dashboard" and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords and objectPermissions.canDestroyObjectRecords and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false) and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canDelete", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 导入 {objectLabelPlural}
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "INDEX_PAGE" and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and permissionFlags.IMPORT_CSV

commandMenuItems.label: 编辑布局
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType != "SETTINGS_PAGE" and not isLayoutCustomizationModeEnabled and permissionFlags.LAYOUTS

commandMenuItems.label: 编辑仪表板
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and not isDashboardPageLayoutInEditMode and not isLayoutCustomizationModeEnabled and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "pageLayoutId") and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords

commandMenuItems.label: 保存仪表板
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and isDashboardPageLayoutInEditMode and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "pageLayoutId") and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords

commandMenuItems.label: 取消编辑
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and isDashboardPageLayoutInEditMode and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "pageLayoutId") and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords

commandMenuItems.label: 激活工作流
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.steps") and every(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.steps.length") and (everyEquals(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.status", "DRAFT") or includesNone(selectedRecords, "statuses", "ACTIVE")) and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 停用工作流
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and (everyEquals(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.status", "ACTIVE") or includesEvery(selectedRecords, "statuses", "ACTIVE")) and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 测试工作流
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.steps") and every(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.steps.length") and ((everyEquals(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger.type", "MANUAL") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger.settings.objectType")) or everyEquals(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger.type", "WEBHOOK") or everyEquals(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger.type", "CRON")) and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 整理工作流
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.trigger") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.steps") and every(selectedRecords, "currentVersion.steps.length") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 复制工作流
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: everyDefined(selectedRecords, "currentVersion") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 将工作流设为私有
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "visibility", "WORKSPACE") and every(selectedRecords, "canChangeVisibility") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 与工作区共享工作流
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "visibility", "PRIVATE") and every(selectedRecords, "canChangeVisibility") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 停止
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: isSelectAll or someEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "NOT_STARTED") or someEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "ENQUEUED") or someEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "RUNNING")

commandMenuItems.label: 新聊天
commandMenuItems.conditionalPinnedExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular == "agentChatThread" and not isInSidePanel

commandMenuItems.label: 询问 AI
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: permissionFlags.AI and not isInSidePanel and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "agentChatThread"

commandMenuItems.label: 发送营销活动
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and (everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "DRAFT") or everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "SCHEDULED")) and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 发送测试邮件
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and (everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "DRAFT") or everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "SCHEDULED")) and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 添加区块
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "DRAFT") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 电子邮件样式
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "DRAFT") and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 取消营销活动
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and (everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "SCHEDULED") or everyEquals(selectedRecords, "status", "SENDING")) and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")

commandMenuItems.label: 标记为已读
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and every(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.isUnread")

commandMenuItems.label: 添加到列表
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: targetObjectWritePermissions.messageListMember and numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and (isSelectAll or noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt"))

commandMenuItems.label: 标记为未读
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.isUnread", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 标记为完成
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.scope", "INBOX")

commandMenuItems.label: 取消稍后处理
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.scope", "SNOOZED")

commandMenuItems.label: 重新打开
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.scope", "ARCHIVED")

commandMenuItems.label: 稍后处理
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyDefined(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus") and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.scope", "SNOOZED")

commandMenuItems.label: 订阅
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.isSubscribed", false)

commandMenuItems.label: 退订
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and everyEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.isSubscribed", true) and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "inboxStatus.isAssignedToMe", true)

commandMenuItems.label: 分配
commandMenuItems.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and permissionFlags.AI and featureFlags.IS_AI_CHAT_INBOX_ENABLED and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false)
